title: Freeze scene-graph, traversal-graph, and environment-spec schemas v1.0
summary: Define and freeze the three data contracts the scene-graph service produces and the Unity runtime and validator consume. Freeze needs an AUTH (design-change); later changes need another.

acceptance_tests.test: data/schemas/scene_graph.json, traversal_graph.json, and environment_spec.json (JSON Schema 2020-12) define surfaces (Bible §4 classes), measurements in A units, the scale multiplier, edges (which surface reaches which by which verb at what difficulty), and the summit/routes/vistas spec with a per-segment beat.
Fixtures validate; at least one invalid fixture per schema is rejected; the validator and a Unity loader both parse the same fixture.
The PR cites APPROVED #n for the freeze; data/schemas/README.md records version 1.0.0 and the change rule.
Reviewed by gj-gameplay (runtime consumer) and gj-platform (packaging).

auth_required.what: Freeze scene_graph / traversal_graph / environment_spec schemas v1.0.0
